art_direction: Small translucent mint-green alien blob with three soft antenna tufts, oversized dark-purple eyes, tiny brass monocle and deliberately ill-fitting navy business suit with crooked yellow tie. Wholly original non-human character designed for lightweight 2D rigging rather than photorealistic human video.
voice: Original soft curious nasal alien voice with gentle synthesized pitch modulation; keep intelligible and no imitation of established characters.
quirk: Records every ordinary device as an inexplicable 'EARTH ARTIFACT' and uses a fake bureaucratic alien checklist.
audience: International shortform tech/gadget audience with humor-first hooks
monetization: Creative commission original character explainer video for clients
Verified accessory affiliate only where commercially and factually suitable

pilot.title: Blop Discovers the USB-C Cable
pilot.sample_script: Blop: Humans made a cable. They made both ends look the same. Then made chargers with seventeen shapes. Fascinating. My advice? Check the connector AND the power rating. End transmission.

shots.visual: Blop bursts out of original drawn spaceship dossier
Original generic unbranded cable rotates in view
Silly grid of abstract connector shapes; no borrowed products
Two highlighted original diagrams: connector shape, charging rating
Blop stamps alien dossier then nods solemnly
